title: Where the Heart Finds Peace, There Is My Home: Changes in Social Status in the Poverty Alleviation Relocation Programme
title_zh: 心安之处即是家：易地扶贫搬迁中的社会地位变迁
title_primary: 心安之处即是家：易地扶贫搬迁中的社会地位变迁
title_secondary: Where the Heart Finds Peace, There Is My Home: Changes in Social Status in the Poverty Alleviation Relocation Programme
authors: Zhao Guoxiong, Boyu Jin, Biao Ma, Chen Zhang
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
abstract: Poverty alleviation relocation is an important component of China's anti‐poverty strategy and has reshaped relocated households' living conditions and social integration. Using the Poverty Alleviation Relocation Programme (PARP) as a quasi‐natural experiment, this study examines the impact of relocation on households' social status based on four‐wave panel data from 1351 households. The results show that relocation significantly improves subjective social status, whereas its effect on objective social status is insignificant. The positive effect is more pronounced among young adults aged 18–44, elderly individuals aged 60 and above, households with lower educational attainment, and those resettled in rural areas. Mechanism analysis suggests that social network expansion and improved life satisfaction are important channels through which relocation enhances perceived social standing. The findings also reveal a significant increase in conspicuous consumption after relocation, suggesting stronger aspirations for upward mobility among relocated households. By extending the analysis from material welfare to the social dimensions of relocation, this study provides new evidence on the social consequences of poverty alleviation relocation and offers implications for subsequent support policies.
abstract_zh: 易地扶贫搬迁是中国反贫困战略的重要组成部分，重塑了搬迁家庭的生活条件与社会融合。本研究以易地扶贫搬迁项目作为准自然实验，基于1351户家庭的四轮面板数据，考察了搬迁对家庭社会地位的影响。结果表明，搬迁显著提升了主观社会地位，而对客观社会地位的影响则不显著。这一积极效应在18至44岁的青年群体、60岁及以上的老年群体、受教育程度较低的家庭以及迁入农村地区的家庭中更为明显。机制分析表明，社交网络扩展和生活满意度提升是搬迁增强感知社会地位的重要渠道。研究结果还显示，搬迁后炫耀性消费显著增加，表明搬迁家庭具有更强的向上流动意愿。通过将分析从物质福利延伸至搬迁的社会维度，本研究为易地扶贫搬迁的社会后果提供了新的证据，并对后续支持政策具有启示意义。

title: The Generalized Jevons Paradox and the Future of Energy
title_zh: 广义杰文斯悖论与能源的未来
title_primary: 广义杰文斯悖论与能源的未来
title_secondary: The Generalized Jevons Paradox and the Future of Energy
authors: Mr. William Oman & Etienne Espagne & Jean-Baptiste Fressoz
official: 官方在线 2026-07-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Global energy and materials are essential to the functioning of the economy and have significant implications for macroeconomics and the environment. At the same time, the world is not on track to meet Paris Agreement goals. This paper documents two stylized facts that connect these observations. First, the world economy is characterized by large embedded emissions and materials: different energies and materials are deeply entwined and interdependent. This has historically led to additive – rather than substitution – dynamics in energy and materials on a global scale. Second, historically there has been a strong positive correlation between efficiency in resource use and total resource use at a global scale. We synthesize these observations by introducing the Generalized Jevons Paradox (GJP). We argue that the GJP reflects the direct and indirect energy/material demand effects of long-term energy and material interdependencies, themselves shaped by market and geoeconomic power, trade arrangements, and financial factors. While future scenarios may diverge from historical data, including because of different population and growth trends, the GJP calls for caution in projecting energy and material flows within the energy transition framework, as it suggests that a declining share of fossil fuels in primary energy consumption can coexist with rising total fossil consumption, and thus rising global emissions – as observed since 2012. The GJP highlights the importance of policies to better allocate energy and material flows across sectors and countries and reduce supply chain vulnerabilities, but raises difficult distributional and political economy questions. Based on the GJP, the paper identifies three areas for research: the detailed analysis of the role of materials in supply chain vulnerabilities; the political economy of material flows; and multidimensional welfare analysis in decarbonization scenarios.
abstract_zh: 全球能源与材料是经济运行的基础，对宏观经济与环境具有深远影响。然而，当前世界尚未走上实现《巴黎协定》目标的轨道。本文揭示了两项连接上述观察的结构性事实：其一，全球经济呈现显著的隐含排放与材料嵌入特征——不同能源与材料之间存在深度交织与相互依存关系，这在历史上导致全球范围内能源与材料呈现"叠加效应"而非"替代效应"；其二，全球尺度上资源利用效率与资源总用量长期呈现强正相关关系。我们通过提出"广义杰文斯悖论"（GJP）来综合这些发现。该理论认为，GJP反映了长期能源与材料相互依存关系所引发的直接与间接能源/材料需求效应，而这类依存关系本身受市场与地缘经济力量、贸易安排及金融因素塑造。尽管未来情景可能因人口与增长趋势差异而偏离历史数据，但GJP警示在能源转型框架下预测能源与材料流动需保持审慎——它表明化石燃料在初级能源消费中占比下降可与化石燃料总消费量上升并存，进而导致全球排放持续增长（正如2012年以来观测到的趋势）。GJP凸显了通过政策优化跨部门与跨国能源材料流动配置、降低供应链脆弱性的重要性，但也引发了棘手的分配与政治经济学问题。基于GJP，本文提出三个研究方向：材料在供应链脆弱性中的具体作用机制、材料流动的政治经济学分析，以及脱碳情景下的多维福利评估。

title: DP20175 Welfare Effects of Social Security With Uninsured Income Risk
title_zh: 未保险收入风险下社会保障的福利效应
title_primary: 未保险收入风险下社会保障的福利效应
title_secondary: DP20175 Welfare Effects of Social Security With Uninsured Income Risk
official: 官方在线 2025-04-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We provide an analytical decomposition of the welfare effect of raising the contribution rate of a pay-as-you-go social security at equilibrium in an overlapping generations economy with productive uncertainty and idiosyncratic labor income risks. Based on the observed long-run pattern of GDP growth and safe rate for most advanced economies, we argue that social security is likely to be a Pareto improving policy due to the over accumulation of capital that arise from individual risk at competitive equilibria. Assuming Epstein-Zin preference representation and Cobb-Douglas technology, the welfare effect can be decomposed into a "direct" effect, which takes into account the inter-generations reallocation of consumption and risk at status quo, a "general equilibrium" effect, that takes into account the reallocation of capital and labor and an "idiosyncratic risk" component. The relevant statistics that affect these two components are the growth-adjusted dominant root of the stochastic discount factor at the competitive equilibrium and the covariance between wages and individual labor productivity. Since the estimated direct and general equilibrium effects are very small, the net effect of social security is almost entirely determined by the idiosyncratic risk component, which is shown to affect positively individuals’ welfare under crowding out.
abstract_zh: 本文在包含生产不确定性和异质性劳动收入风险的代际交叠经济中，对现收现付制社会保障缴费率提高的福利效应进行了分析性分解。基于多数发达经济体观察到的GDP增长与安全利率的长期模式，我们认为，由于竞争均衡中个体风险导致的资本过度积累，社会保障很可能是一项帕累托改进政策。在采用Epstein-Zin偏好表示和Cobb-Douglas技术的假设下，福利效应可分解为：考虑现状下代际间消费与风险再分配的"直接效应"、考虑资本与劳动再分配的"一般均衡效应"，以及"异质性风险"成分。影响这两类成分的相关统计量包括竞争均衡下经增长调整的随机贴现因子主导根，以及工资与个体劳动生产率之间的协方差。由于估计的直接效应和一般均衡效应非常微小，社会保障的净效应几乎完全由异质性风险成分决定，而该成分在挤出效应下被证明对个体福利具有正向影响。

title: Two-Sided Market Pricing with Heterogeneous Users: Theory and App-lication
title_zh: 异质用户的双边市场定价：理论与应用
title_primary: 异质用户的双边市场定价：理论与应用
title_secondary: Two-Sided Market Pricing with Heterogeneous Users: Theory and App-lication
authors: Simon Anderson, Ozlem Bedre Defolie, Andrey Simonov, Daniil Mikhailov, Ruben Enikolopov 等
official: 官方在线 2025-10-03 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop a tractable model of a platform, like an app store, where heterogeneous sellers and consumers interact. Sellers vary in quality and face entry costs, while consumers differ in valuation for quality and usage intensity. The platform sets a consumer participation fee and an ad valorem commission on sellers. Two endogenous aggregates—the stock of seller quality and the value of participating consumers—create cross-side network effects. We characterize the equilibrium allocations and fees, and illustrate a key ratio of seller revenue to consumer surplus governing distortions in seller and consumer participation. The framework delivers sharp implications for current policy debates on app store regulation: commission caps or third-party payment mandates can reduce consumer surplus by raising consumer fees. If the platform owns some high-quality apps, it sets a lower commission and a higher consumer fee, reducing consumer participation. Our model also incorporates ad-financed apps, membership-financed apps, and other digital ecosystems.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个可处理的平台模型（如应用商店），其中异质性卖家与消费者进行互动。卖家在质量上存在差异并面临进入成本，而消费者对质量的评价和使用强度各不相同。平台设定消费者参与费用和基于卖家交易额的佣金。两个内生总量——卖家质量存量与参与消费者的价值——产生了跨边网络效应。我们刻画了均衡配置与费用结构，并揭示了决定卖家与消费者参与扭曲的关键比率：卖家收入与消费者剩余之比。该框架对当前应用商店监管政策辩论具有明确启示：佣金上限或第三方支付强制要求可能通过提高消费者费用而降低消费者剩余。若平台拥有部分高质量应用，其将设定更低的佣金和更高的消费者费用，从而减少消费者参与。我们的模型还纳入了广告支持型应用、会员制应用及其他数字生态系统。

title: DP47 The Economics of Old Age in Britain: A Long-Run View, 1881-1981
title_zh: 英国老年经济学：长期视角，1881-1981
title_primary: 英国老年经济学：长期视角，1881-1981
title_secondary: DP47 The Economics of Old Age in Britain: A Long-Run View, 1881-1981
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The substantial rise in the proportion of elderly (65+) people in the British population over the last hundred years has been matched by a dramatic fall in labour-force participation rates among the elderly. Some commentators see the reduction in work opportunities for the eldery and their increasing reliance on state pensions to avoid poverty as a deliberate construct of successive governments. This paper shows that the economic dependency of the elderly is more clearly a function of long-established employment practices and patterns of asset accumulation. Information drawn from the decennial censuses since 1881 on the occupations of elderly males shows a consistent marginalization of elderly workers in low-wage, low-status occupations. Data on asset-holdings demonstrate that the elderly have a high probability of spending their last years in poverty. This casts doubt on the appropriateness of the life-cycle savings model as a description of the savings behaviour of most workers in 20th century Britain.
abstract_zh: 过去一百年间，英国65岁以上老年人口比例显著上升，与此同时老年人口劳动参与率急剧下降。部分评论者认为，老年人工作机会减少及其对国家养老金依赖度的加深以避免贫困，是历届政府刻意构建的结果。本文表明，老年人的经济依赖性更清晰地源于长期形成的雇佣惯例与资产积累模式。基于1881年以来十年一次的人口普查中老年男性职业信息显示，老年工人持续被边缘化至低工资、低地位职业。资产持有数据表明，老年人晚年陷入贫困的概率极高。这一发现对生命周期储蓄模型作为20世纪英国多数工人储蓄行为描述的适用性提出了质疑。

title: Recovering Within-Country Inequality From Trade Data,
title_zh: 从贸易数据中恢复国内不平等程度
title_primary: 从贸易数据中恢复国内不平等程度
title_secondary: Recovering Within-Country Inequality From Trade Data,
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper develops a novel method to estimate inequality within a country based on what the country imports. If preferences are non-homothetic, rich and poor individuals of a country have different consumption profiles. Imports can thus inform about the income distribution in a country. The global availability of trade data allows us to estimate inequality using a single transparent and comparable method for a large sample of countries over time. Compared to conventional data, we feature an especially good coverage of developing countries. We provide a number of robustness checks and cross-validation exercises that show the good performance of our method.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于国家进口数据估算国内不平等程度的新方法。若偏好具有非位似性，一国富人与穷人的消费结构将呈现差异。因此，进口数据可揭示该国的收入分配状况。利用全球可获取的贸易数据，我们能够通过单一透明且可比的方法，对大量国家在时间序列上的不平等程度进行估算。与传统数据相比，本方法对发展中国家的覆盖尤为充分。我们通过多项稳健性检验与交叉验证，证实了该方法具有良好的表现。

title: DP21639 Sanctions, Financial Frictions, and the Organization of Conflict
title_zh: 制裁、金融摩擦与冲突的组织
title_primary: 制裁、金融摩擦与冲突的组织
title_secondary: DP21639 Sanctions, Financial Frictions, and the Organization of Conflict
official: 官方在线 2026-06-18 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies whether financial sanctions increase the financial frictions faced by terrorist groups and how these affect their organization. We exploit staggered sanctions on Pakistani terrorist leaders, linked to unique administrative data matching leaders' identities to charity board composition. After sanctions, associates of sanctioned terrorist leaders create more charities, exposed charities raise more funds, and affected groups splinter into factions. This reallocates terror: attacks increase in Pakistan but decline in the US and Western Europe. A multi-agent LLM analyzes qualitative evidence and yields friction intervals with a midpoint near 20 percent, comparable to a wealth tax on terrorist organizations.
abstract_zh: 本文研究金融制裁是否加剧了恐怖组织面临的金融摩擦，以及这些摩擦如何影响其组织结构。我们利用对巴基斯坦恐怖头目的分阶段制裁，结合独特的行政数据，将头目身份与慈善机构董事会构成进行匹配。制裁后，受制裁恐怖头目的关联人员创建了更多慈善机构，受影响的慈善机构筹集了更多资金，而相关恐怖组织则分裂为多个派系。这导致恐怖活动重新分布：巴基斯坦境内的袭击增加，而美国及西欧的袭击减少。一个多智能体大语言模型对定性证据进行分析，得出摩擦区间中点约为20%，相当于对恐怖组织征收财富税。

title: Skill and Efficiency in the U.S. Mutual Fund Industry
title_zh: 美国共同基金行业的技能与效率
title_primary: 美国共同基金行业的技能与效率
title_secondary: Skill and Efficiency in the U.S. Mutual Fund Industry
authors: Dong Hwan Oh, Andrew J. Patton
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We propose a new measure of mutual fund manager ability: "efficiency" is the ability to accrue the risk premium associated with a risk factor. The familiar abnormal return, or alpha, is shown to be the sum of two distinct measures of ability: "aggregate efficiency" which is the beta-weighted sum of the fund's (in)efficiencies across risk factors, and "skill," the component that is unrelated to factor exposures. Using a panel of U.S. equity mutual fund returns from 1999-2023, we document significant heterogeneity in mutual fund manager skill and efficiency. We employ regression trees and their extensions to capture this heterogeneity. We find that efficiency is more persistent than skill, and we show that future abnormal returns can be better predicted by decomposing lagged abnormal returns into skill and efficiency.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种衡量共同基金经理能力的新指标：“效率”是指获取与风险因子相关的风险溢价的能力。常见的异常收益（即阿尔法）被证明是两种不同能力指标的总和：“总体效率”——即基金在各风险因子上的（低）效率的贝塔加权总和，以及“技能”——与因子暴露无关的部分。利用1999年至2023年美国股票共同基金回报的面板数据，我们记录了共同基金经理技能与效率的显著异质性。我们采用回归树及其扩展方法来捕捉这种异质性。研究发现，效率比技能更具持续性，并且通过将滞后异常收益分解为技能和效率，可以更好地预测未来的异常收益。

title: Entrepreneurship and Financial Deregulation
abstract: We quantitatively analyze the impact of US banking deregulation in the 1980s on the aggregate economy. Using recent econometric techniques, we first reexamine existing empirical evidence on the real effects of banking deregulation. We then construct a quantitative model that integrates imperfectly competitive banks into a general equilibrium framework of firm dynamics and occupational choice. Consistent with the empirical evidence, deregulation significantly increases output growth and firm entry. Increased competition among banks and the entrepreneurs' occupational choices play an important role in shaping the economy's response to deregulation.
abstract_zh: 本文定量分析了20世纪80年代美国银行业放松管制对总体经济的影响。利用最新的计量经济学方法，我们首先重新审视了关于银行业放松管制实际效应的现有实证证据。随后，我们构建了一个将不完全竞争银行纳入企业动态与职业选择一般均衡框架的定量模型。与实证证据一致，放松管制显著提升了产出增长与企业进入率。银行间竞争的加剧以及企业家的职业选择在塑造经济对放松管制的反应中发挥了关键作用。

title: Existence of Myopic‐Farsighted Stable Sets in Matching Markets
title_zh: 匹配市场中短视-远视稳定集的存在性
title_primary: 匹配市场中短视-远视稳定集的存在性
title_secondary: Existence of Myopic‐Farsighted Stable Sets in Matching Markets
abstract: In the context of one‐to‐one matching markets, we study myopic‐farsighted stable sets , which are internally and externally stable when myopic agents consider immediate payoffs from their deviations, while farsighted agents anticipate counter‐deviations and consider final payoffs. We constructively prove the existence of a (rational expectations) myopic‐farsighted stable set, in which farsighted agents receive a single payoff while myopic agents may receive multiple payoffs. Our existence result extends to settings with enforcing coalitions of arbitrary size, yielding coalitional myopic‐farsighted stable sets , and to settings where not all members of an enforcing coalition must strictly gain, yielding myopic‐farsighted weakly stable sets . When all farsighted agents have unit demand, our results also extend to many‐to‐one matching markets. As a key corollary, we provide a foundation for the efficiency‐adjusted deferred acceptance algorithm by showing that its outcome constitutes a singleton myopic‐farsighted stable set when one side is farsighted and the other is myopic.
abstract_zh: 在一对一匹配市场的背景下，我们研究了近视-远视稳定集，当近视主体考虑其偏离行为的即时收益，而远视主体预期反偏离并考虑最终收益时，该集合在内部和外部均保持稳定。我们构造性地证明了（理性预期）近视-远视稳定集的存在性，其中远视主体获得单一收益，而近视主体可能获得多重收益。我们的存在性结果扩展至具有任意规模执行联盟的情形，从而产生联盟性近视-远视稳定集，并进一步扩展至执行联盟中并非所有成员必须严格获益的情形，从而产生近视-远视弱稳定集。当所有远视主体具有单位需求时，我们的结果也适用于多对一匹配市场。作为一个关键推论，我们为效率调整的延迟接受算法提供了理论基础，表明当一方为远视而另一方为近视时，其结果构成一个单元素近视-远视稳定集。

title: Can public works increase caste-based conflicts? Evidence from India’s National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
title_zh: 公共工程会加剧种姓冲突吗？来自印度全国农村就业保障计划的证据

authors: Shampa Bhattacharjee, Agrani Gupta, Radhani Jagadish Kumar, Arka Roy Chaudhuri
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies whether the world’s largest workfare scheme reduces targeted violence against marginalized groups. Leveraging the district-wise phased rollout of the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS), we employ a difference-in-differences design to identify the causal impact of MGNREGS implementation on targeted crimes against disadvantaged caste groups. Our findings show a significant increase in reported caste-based crimes following the scheme’s introduction. We discuss and provide suggestive evidence on the mechanisms.

title: The Origin of the State: Land Productivity or Appropriability? Comment
title_zh: 国家的起源：土地生产力还是可占有性？评论
title_primary: 国家的起源：土地生产力还是可占有性？评论
title_secondary: The Origin of the State: Land Productivity or Appropriability? Comment
authors: Nikolai Cook, Thibaut Duprey, Anthony Heyes, Martino Pelli
abstract: Mayshar, Moav, and Pascali apply an instrumental variables identification strategy to data from nearly 1,000 societies included in the Ethnographic Atlas to claim that cultivation of cereals (appropriable by elites), rather than increased land productivity following the adoption of agriculture, led to the development of the state. We show two things. (1) Evidence for the appropriability theory holds when moving from a tribe-chiefdom to a state and not more broadly. (2) Conclusions are driven by a handful of outliers with statistical significance at the 10% level lost with winsorization at 2.1% (or trimming at 1.2%) of locations by cereal advantage.

title: Catching the technological frontier? Vocational and technical education (VTE) and inventive activity in Italy, 1861–1911
title_zh: 追赶技术前沿？意大利职业与技术教育（VTE）与发明活动（1861–1911）
title_primary: 追赶技术前沿？意大利职业与技术教育（VTE）与发明活动（1861–1911）
title_secondary: Catching the technological frontier? Vocational and technical education (VTE) and inventive activity in Italy, 1861–1911
authors: Gabriele Cappelli, Pau Insa‐Sánchez, Michelangelo Vasta
abstract: Abstract Italy's slow human capital accumulation during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries is a key determinant of the limited inventive activity of the country. Whilst the education–innovation nexus was explored in previous research, the relationship between the diffusion of vocational and technical education (VTE) and inventive activity has not been assessed. In this paper, we present a brand‐new dataset of VTE schools across Italy's provinces in the period 1861–1911 and perform a two‐stage analysis. First, we investigate factors associated with the establishment of VTE schools. Second, we study the correlation between VTE and innovation using new patent data. The diffusion of VTE schools was linked to socio‐economic factors, highlighting the role of demand. In turn, the presence of VTE schools correlates with an increasing number of patents. We show that the VTE–innovation nexus was influenced by existing human capital levels, particularly the relative diffusion of mass education versus secondary schooling.

title: Redistributive Policy Shocks and Monetary Policy with Heterogeneous Agents
title_zh: 再分配政策冲击与异质性主体下的货币政策
title_primary: 再分配政策冲击与异质性主体下的货币政策
title_secondary: Redistributive Policy Shocks and Monetary Policy with Heterogeneous Agents
authors: OJASVITA BAHL, CHETAN GHATE, DEBDULAL MALLICK
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
abstract: Abstract Governments in EMDEs routinely intervene in agricultural markets to stabilize food prices in response to adverse shocks. Such interventions involve a large increase in the procurement and redistribution of agricultural output, which we refer to as a redistributive policy shock. What is the impact of a redistributive policy shock on inflation and the distribution of consumption among rich and poor households? We build a two‐sector‐two‐agent NK‐DSGE model and estimate it for India using Bayesian methods. We characterize optimal monetary policy and show that the welfare costs of redistributive policy shocks are significantly higher under nonoptimized rules.
abstract_zh: 摘要 新兴市场与发展中经济体（EMDEs）的政府经常干预农产品市场，以应对不利冲击并稳定食品价格。此类干预涉及农产品采购和再分配的大幅增加，我们将其称为再分配政策冲击。再分配政策冲击对通货膨胀以及富裕和贫困家庭之间消费分布的影响是什么？我们构建了一个两部门、两主体的新凯恩斯动态随机一般均衡（NK-DSGE）模型，并采用贝叶斯方法对印度进行估计。我们刻画了最优货币政策，并表明在非优化规则下，再分配政策冲击的福利成本显著更高。
